product.name: Deep Insight
product.description: A digital twin platform for visualizing, automating, and optimizing oil and gas assets in a 3D environment.

product.name: AlphaSpace
product.description: A software tool to automate well casing tally workflows in oil and gas operations.

product.name: AlphaStim
product.description: A tool to automate the design of straddle and plug and perf fracture treatments in oil and gas wells.

product.name: Pipelines
product.description: A software tool to automate pipeline design workflows in oil and gas infrastructure projects.
